rules.title: Cartwright Act: Common Pricing Algorithm Prohibition
rules.requirement: It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter. It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.citation: California Business and Professions Code Section 16729(a) and (b), AB 325 Chapter 338
rules.quoted_span:
It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
(b) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to use or distribution of a common pricing algorithm as part of contract, combination in trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade; or use with coercion to adopt recommended price or commercial term for same or similar products or services in California
rules.sanctions: Violation constitutes crime or infraction under California law; state-mandated local program applies to enforcement
